text_simplified: The text includes noble Prophetic hadiths about the rights of children and their tarbiyah (upbringing). The noble hadith highlights the importance of justice among children in giving and love. It also points to the necessity of raising children upon taqwa (God-consciousness) and good akhlaq (character).

review_defects.english: The noble hadith highlights the importance of justice
review_defects.why: The Arabic verb 'يذكر' means 'mentions' or 'states', not 'highlights'; 'highlights' adds an emphasis not present in the source.
The English 'upon taqwa' is a literal rendering of the Arabic preposition 'على' and sounds stiff and unnatural; a more idiomatic translation would be 'with taqwa' or 'in taqwa'.
